purpose: Teach: 譴/發/ココログ/茲/兇/廚/李/眞

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、内部規律違反には譴責処分もされますね
lines.en: The police do issue disciplinary reprimands for internal regulation violations, don't they.
lines.style: Measured, informational tone. Slight upward lilt at the end—genuinely curious, not challenging. Steady pacing, like moving through a checklist with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、戦前の「發砲」記録を、警察、参照されますね
lines.en: The police do reference prewar firing records, don't they.
lines.style: Same measured pace. Factual delivery without judgment. Small pause before the final phrase, as if mentally filing this detail away. Attentive rather than hurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者のブログ、ココログ投稿も解析されますね
lines.en: The police do analyze suspects' blog posts on Cocolog, don't they.
lines.style: Slightly more engaged. The word 'analyze' gets a subtle emphasis—recognition of methodical work. Still conversational, not lecturing. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、「茲に告示する」と正式文書を発行されますね
lines.en: The police do issue formal documents with official proclamations like that, don't they.
lines.style: Lighter touch here—almost appreciative of the formality. Gentle phrasing around 'official proclamations.' Still warm and inquisitive, but with a hint of recognition that this is how institutions work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の兇器、つまり凶器を厳重に押収されますね
lines.en: The police do carefully seize weapons found at the scene, don't they.
lines.style: Slight gravitational shift—more serious now. 'Carefully' gets quiet emphasis. Pace steadies. Not alarmed, but respectful of the gravity of evidence handling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の廚房、つまり厨房も鑑識されますね
lines.en: The police do conduct forensic examination of the kitchen area at the scene, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the more serious register. Clinical but not cold. 'Forensic examination' delivered with professional weight. Still Kenji's warmth, but focused.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者の李さんから事情を、警察、丁寧に聴かれますね
lines.en: The police do carefully take statements from eyewitnesses like Mr. Li, don't they.
lines.style: Back to warmth. 'Carefully' gets quiet care in the delivery. Genuine interest in the methodical approach to witness testimony. Conversational rhythm returns—less clinical than the previous line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の眞さん、つまり真田さんの調書を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The police do prepare thorough statements from victims like Mr. Sanada, don't they.
lines.style: Closing with quiet respect. 'Thorough' carries weight but not weight. Slight downward softening at the very end—acknowledgment of the seriousness of victim care. Warm but grounded.
